_comment: Per-clip replay cache for single-goal.mov — the precomputed vision evidence the interpreter replays with zero live Azure calls (design D1 hero path). `detect` holds the REAL Azure AI Vision boxes returned at the 4.625s sampled frame (5 people; p_messi is the conf-0.75 left box). `read_text` is the hand-verified pin for the hero #10 (source:pinned) because Azure Read misreads the WC font and gpt-4o vision is quota-blocked. `events` is the known goal moment. Keys in `detect` are sampled-frame timestamps in ms.

p_messi.note: Hand-verified. Azure Read misreads the stylized WC numeral (22 -> 77); gpt-4o vision pending TPM quota. The 10 is human-legible and pinned for the hero query (disclosed in the demo).
